text:
jamie: Heads up — since ~02:00 UTC we've seen a sharp spike in Prometheus remote_write p95 and a bunch of scrape timeouts from gpu-exporter in us-west2. Alerts: RemoteWriteQueueLength > 500 and Scrape timeout errors ~15%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/prom-remotewrite?view=us-west2

deploy-bot: prometheus-agent v2.3.1 rolled to us-west2 at 01:58 UTC (changelog: relabeling bugfixes + agent restart behavior)

priya: saw the alerts. Do we have the agent relabel config that shipped? could be adding high-card labels like pod_name/container_id — that kills series counts. :eyes:

jamie: pasted the job relabel snippet I pulled from the agent rollout:
```yaml
- job_name: gpu-exporter
  kubernetes_sd_configs: []
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
    target_label: pod_name
    action: replace
```
This will add pod_name to all exporter metrics (wasn't present before) — enormous cardinality with our autoscaling pods.

marco: yep that's the culprit. When cardinality jumps the remote_write queue backs up and combined with the transient CNI flaps we see timeouts -> 504s. Two-pronged fix: drop pod_name and container_id at scrape, and increase remote_write buffering (queue_capacity, batch_size/timeouts) until we can fully flatten metrics.

tina: noted — there was a node rolling upgrade and CNI flaps in us-west2 between 01:50-02:05 UTC. IP churn + kube-proxy conn resets logged. The agent rollout coincided with that window (01:57 start). Might be correlated.

priya: proposal action items:
1) Add metric_relabel_configs to gpu-exporter job to DROP labels: pod_name, container_id, container_hash, and ip
2) Add a relabel to collapse any gpu UUID labels we don't need
3) Canary the change in us-west2-staging first

Suggested relabel snippet:
```yaml
metric_relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [pod_name]
  action: drop
- source_labels: [container_id]
  action: drop
- regex: 'gpu_.*_temp'
  action: replace
  replacement: 'gpu_temp'
```

jamie: temporary mitigations while we roll relabels: raise remote_write timeout and buffer sizes on the agent so it tolerates short spikes. Example changes: remote_timeout: 1m, remote_write_queue_capacity: 200000, batch_send_deadline: 30s. Also add an alert suppression (for 10m) on RemoteWriteQueueLength to avoid noisy pages during rollout.

marco: I'll open a PR for both: relabel drop + agent config bump. Will add a dashboard panel for "series_count by job" and a small playback of series growth so we can see before/after. Assigning PR to @priya for review.

priya: ack, will review. Also we should consider moving some high-cardinality metrics into a push-gateway or exposing aggregated series (sum by (instance,gpu_uuid)) instead of raw per-pod labels.

tina: Ops note — I'll pause any further node rolling upgrades in us-west2 until we confirm agent patch and relabel are live.

jamie: thanks. After relabel lands we'll monitor series_count, remote_write latency, and queue_length. If we still see high p95 we can revert the agent rollout. Ping me if alerts spike again. :thumbsup:

priya: quick question — does cortex show any blocked shards or write errors? I saw a few 429s in the proxy logs at 02:03. If so we should consider temporarily routing to another region or enabling fallback model routing for non-critical metrics.

marco: proxy logs show short 429 burst coincident with queue backpressure. I'll escalate if it persists. For now action plan: PR -> canary us-west2-staging -> monitor 30m -> promote to prod.

jamie: cool. I'll add a runbook blurb for future rollouts to check relabel diffs and series_count pre/post.

priya: thanks all.

jamie: (reminder) if anyone wants to test locally the relabel behavior you can run: `promtool check config prometheus.yml` or `prometheus --config.file=prometheus.yml --log.level=debug` to validate.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #4523 (prometheus:gpu-exporter-relabel)

jamie: ok locking this thread, follow-up in PR comments.
